text:
Type: fringed fleece throw
Use: warmth and color on a sofa, an armchair or a bed; living room, bedroom, children's room
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: soft polyester fleece, short cut fringe along the ends, zigzag stitched edges
Colors: bright grass green, turquoise blue, navy, pale cream
Shape: folded flat rectangular blanket with a short cut fringe on the ends, smooth plain surface, light and thin
Feel: cozy, cheerful, casual, soft
Goes with: white or grey sofas, bright accents, light wood; casual family living rooms and children's rooms

product.name: MAJJE
product.description: The fleece throw feels soft against your skin and can be machine washed.
